title: windowless_kwargs hands the caller's inherited stdin, stdout and stderr to an attached child, so a windowless child's output still reaches its caller
intention: windowless_kwargs(os_name=None, *, given=None), when given is passed, adds stdin, stdout and stderr taken from sys.stdin, sys.stdout and sys.stderr for each std stream the caller did not name in given and that has a usable fileno, beside CREATE_NO_WINDOW, so a child started with the helper's keywords writes to the caller's stdout instead of a new hidden console; with given left out it returns exactly what it returns today.
why: Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendell while building 0d7dcc7b667a: with an inherited stdout pipe and no console, a child started with **windowless_kwargs() prints nothing (CREATE_NO_WINDOW without STARTF_USESTDHANDLES gives it a new hidden console); a bare child prints; explicit stdin/stdout/stderr = sys.std* fixes it. The helper's contract breaks inherited stdio for every caller that spreads it, so the fix is once, here. cc_0's hypothesis (set CREATE_NO_WINDOW only when GetConsoleWindow() == 0) is FALSIFIED by the same measurement: the failing parent has GetConsoleWindow 0. A true console parent was not measured (needs a visible window). Akien 2026-11-20: popups while he works are annoying.
traces_to: CP4; Law 3 (measured); Law 1 (one helper, fixed once).
how: In cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py, add keyword-only given=None to windowless_kwargs. None: return as today (creationflags only on nt, {} elsewhere), so cairn/devices/tester/runs.py:73's OR-merge is unchanged. Otherwise, for each of stdin, stdout, stderr not in given whose sys stream has a usable fileno (not None, fileno() works), add key = that stream. Proof cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_windowless_kwargs_hands_inherited_stdio_through.py, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: from a parent with no console and an inherited stdout pipe, a bare subprocess.call of a child that prints, with **windowless_kwargs(given=()), delivers the print to the caller
from a pythonw parent the same call opens no console window and exits 0, and adds no stream keyword for a stream that is None
a caller that passes stdout=PIPE through windowless_kwargs(given=('stdout',)) still captures, with no duplicate keyword
a caller's own stdin named in given is not overwritten by sys.stdin
windowless_kwargs('nt') with given omitted returns creationflags only, so the tester's OR-merge still reads integers

decisions.text: D1: windowless_kwargs takes keyword-only given and hands through the std streams not named in it (clauses 1-5).
D2: the proof, one tooth per clause; the pythonw tooth runs only on nt and records not-run elsewhere.

measured.saw: tool-shell parent (inherited pipe, GetConsoleWindow 0): bare child prints; **windowless_kwargs() child prints nothing; capture_output with it captures; explicit stdout=sys.stdout prints. pythonw and powershell -Command parents: GetConsoleWindow 0 as well
measured.how: a scratch script in the session scratchpad running the same print child three ways under python, pythonw and powershell; bin/cairn.py test --list printed nothing with the three subprocess.call sites edited and printed usage unedited

Read the diff: windowless_kwargs(os_name=None, *, given=None) — given omitted returns creationflags only on nt and {} elsewhere (clause 5, the tester's OR-merge at runs.py:73 untouched); given passed adds stdin/stdout/stderr = the sys stream for each key not in given whose stream is not None and has a fileno (clauses 1-4). Ran test_windowless_kwargs_hands_inherited_stdio_through.py here under the tester seal: clauses 1, 3, 4, 5 green, clause 2 UNMEASURED (pythonw/console are Windows-only; akiendell's Windows seal + 1/1 hollow-clean at f57bffd6f carries it). The neighbouring test_every_detached_spawn_takes_its_flags_from_the_helper.py: 5/5 green. Noted, not a defect: off Windows given=() also hands the sys streams through; on POSIX that is the same fds the child inherits, so behaviour is unchanged.
